To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
entrepreneurial ventures are created and sustained by the entrepreneurs’ ability to navigate the challenges of regime changes through a set of capabilities.

entrepreneurial ventures are created by entrepreneurs who, in environments of regime changes, equip their ventures with organizational capabilities that enable the ventures to survive and grow in spite of the regime change.

entrepreneurial ventures that successfully navigate regime change do so by developing capabilities to adapt to the changing environment, to develop and maintain relations with stakeholders, to create and maintain a positive image, to manage the organization, and to develop and maintain an entrepreneurial mindset.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how entrepreneurs’ actions contribute to their ventures’ capabilities to successfully navigate regime change.
how entrepreneurs create and develop capabilities for their ventures to navigate the challenges of regime changes and to achieve sustainable growth.
how the entrepreneurial actions of the venture founders, and their efforts to build and maintain the venture’s capabilities, influence the venture’s sustainability and growth.
